name: Snyk Code
tagline: Developer-focused SAST built on Snyk's DeepCode AI engine, with PR checks and AI fix suggestions across major git platforms.
pricing: Free: 100 Code tests/mo (5 projects); Team: flat $25/mo for teams up to 10 developers (1,000 tests/mo, 100 projects), not per-contributor; Enterprise: credit-based Platform Subscription ($1 = 1 credit; Snyk Code = 1.0 credit/active contributor/day), custom pricing. The former per-contributor "Ignite" tier is no longer listed on the live plans page.
selfHostedNote: SaaS platform; Snyk Broker (Enterprise-only) connects private SCMs, and Snyk Code Local Engine (Early Access, Enterprise-only) runs scans in your network, though results still sync to Snyk's hosted UI.
modelControl: Fixed vendor engine (DeepCode AI, hybrid symbolic + ML); no BYOK or model choice

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Cross-file interprocedural taint analysis within a repo; no multi-repo or ticket context.

02-rule-centric.note: Deterministic security rules with custom rules on higher tiers; scope limited to security findings.

03-dual-workflow.note: IDE plugins, CLI, and PR checks with inline comments cover both local and PR workflows.

04-business-logic.note: No validation against tickets or requirements; security-focused analysis only.

05-continuous-learning.note: DeepCode AI trains on open-source data; no documented learning from your team's review feedback.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Static analysis only; no sandbox execution of code or fixes.

07-economic-transparency.note: No model choice or BYOK; Team is flat-rate (not per-contributor) and Enterprise is credit-based per-active-contributor/day, both with vendor-managed models.

08-actionability.note: DeepCode AI Fix offers one-click fix suggestions in the IDE; PR checks flag issues without committing fixes.

09-measurable-roi.note: Security reporting (issue trends, fix rates) in the platform; no dev-cycle or review-ROI metrics.
